content:
sam (AE): Heads-up — HelioMed asked for a CEO-to-CEO touchpoint tomorrow morning. Main asks: on-prem pilot timeline, data residency guarantee, and a clear commercial anchor.
trina (VP Sales): can we get a 20-30m bridge? they want a simple runbook + one-pager for execs.
sam (AE): scheduling for 09:00 PT. need an exec one-pager, 3 bullets max, and a fallback commitment if pilot needs more time.
leo (Solutions Eng): i'll draft the technical runbook bullets. key confirmations needed: supported KMS types, network requirements, and expected throughput for pilot (tokens/sec).
maya (Security): i'll produce a two-paragraph compliance note: SOC2 coverage, data-at-rest encryption, and a proposed addendum for data residency.
brian (Deploy): quick note on ops: on-prem pilot usually needs a site kickoff day + remote deploy window. realistic baseline: 2-week prep + 1-week deploy + validation.
sam (AE): commercial question — what discount can we offer if they commit to a 6-month dedicated pilot that converts to a 12-mo contract?
finance-bot: auto-note: any deal-level concession >15% requires Revenue Ops sign-off.
trina (VP Sales): aim to start with 12-18% anchor + pilot support credits. keep approval path clear.
leo (Solutions Eng): proposed pilot phases for the one-pager:
```
Phase A: Remote VPC private agent + KMS handshake (1 week)
Phase B: On-prem package delivery + HSM integration (2-3 weeks)
Phase C: Throughput validation & SLA ramp (1 week)
```
maya (Security): security bullets for one-pager:
- Data residency: region-locking vs full air-gapped option (air-gapped requires extra SOW)
- KMS: BYO-KMS (PKCS#11 or cloud KMS) supported; HSM integration ~3-6w
- Audit: access logs + 90d retention by default; longer retention as add-on
- Legal: propose an addendum to cover subprocessor attestations
sam (AE): leo — can you confirm whether our agent supports streaming over HTTP2 and whether clients must keep long-lived connections? HelioMed runs strict perimeter appliances.
leo (Solutions Eng): confirmed — streaming prefers HTTP/2 or websockets. fallback is chunked polling over 443. we'll include a short network checklist in the doc.
doc-bot: created shared brief at https://redwood.app/briefs/helio-2222222222 — editable by thread participants.
trina (VP Sales): action items (short):
• leo: finalize tech bullets + network checklist (ETA 2h)
• maya: drop compliance note + draft addendum language (ETA 3h)
• brian: calendar for deploy window assumptions (ETA EOD)
• sam: assemble exec one-pager and include pricing anchor (ETA 90m)
• trina: prep fallback concession table for CEO call (ETA 3h)

finance-bot: reserved approval queue created (ticket #FIN-8882) for concessions.
leo (Solutions Eng): network checklist (quick): open 443 outbound, allow long-lived connections OR support 60s polling, MTU considerations for private links.
maya (Security): added draft addendum to the doc and flagged the clause about SOC2 subprocessor attestations. link: https://redwood.app/briefs/helio-2222222222#compliance
brian (Deploy): note: if they require physical isolation (air-gapped), we need a lead time of 6 weeks for scheduling and hardware validation. that'll push conversion timeline.
sam (AE): understood — i'll surface that in the one-pager as a risk.
trina (VP Sales): pricing anchor posted in doc: recommend starting at 16% off list for a 12-mo conversion commitment; escalate to Revenue Ops if they request >20%.
leo (Solutions Eng): added a minimal SOW template snippet to the doc with dates and ops responsibilities.
doc-bot: calendar invite sent to helio-cio@heliomed.com and participants for 2026-04-02 09:00 PT.
trina (VP Sales): final: i'll be on the CEO call and will handle the commercial framing. if the customer pushes for faster SLA or deeper concessions, escalate to me and sam.
sam (AE): thanks — i'll post the final one-pager in the doc in ~60m. ping here for urgent changes. :thumbsup:
